prompt_preview: The Evaluator sent this explanation back: it speaks of a gap, but the code found no gap for Target; the accepted findings are: duplicate, early stop, restateme…
text: Target's revenue series since 2009 contains three reliability problems. An early stop occurs at 2015-01-31, where the last reported value of $72,618,000,000 for the annual period ending 2015-01-31 leaves later periods unreported despite the request extending to 2025-10-26. A restatement affects the annual period 2013-02-03 to 2014-02-01, which shifted from $72,596,000,000 to $71,279,000,000, a $1,317,000,000 decline. Duplicate reporting inflates row counts, as quarterly periods in 2009 and 2010 each appear across multiple 10-K and 10-Q filings, meaning summed or counted figures would double-count revenue. These findings mark the series as not clean.
